code: library(PhysioMSKNet)  # --- Build a hypergraph from bundled data --- inc <- loadIncidenceMatrix() hg <- MSKHypergraph(inc) print(hg)  # --- Compute network metrics --- metrics <- mskNetworkMetrics(hg) metrics$degree metrics$betweenness metrics$modularity  # --- Perturbation-based impact analysis --- impact <- mskImpactScoreAll(hg) head(sort(impact, decreasing = TRUE))  # --- Detect communities --- comm <- mskCommunityDetect(hg) profile <- mskCommunityProfile(hg, comm)  # --- Visualize --- plotMSKNetwork(hg, community = comm) plotImpactVsDegree(hg, impact) plotHomunculus(hg, values = impact)  # --- Cross-modal: map EMG to MSK network --- emg_map <- emgToMSKMapping(   emg_channels = c("TA", "SOL", "GM", "GL", "RF", "VL", "VM", "BF"),   hypergraph = hg ) emgCommunityCompare(emg_map, comm)  # --- Clinical prediction --- predictor <- mskClinicalPredictor(   features = metrics,   outcome = patient_scores,   method = "lasso" ) mskPredictFunctionalOutcome(predictor, new_features)  # --- Neuromechanics --- synergies <- neuromechMuscleSynergy(emg_data, n_synergies = 4) neuromechSummary(hg, emg_data, imu_data)

title: PhysioMSKNet 0.1.0
text: Initial release standalone package x-biosignal ecosystem. PhysioMSKNet brings network-science analysis human musculoskeletal system R, implementing hypergraph model Murphy et al. (2018, PLOS Biology) bridging multi-modal physiological signals (EMG, MoCap, IMU, EEG, OpenSim) rehabilitation-oriented analysis.

title: PhysioMSKNet 0.1.0
text: MSKHypergraph() constructs model sparse incidence matrix, bundled 173-bone x 270-muscle anatomical dataset loadable via loadMSKData(), loadIncidenceMatrix(), loadMuscleMetadata(), loadValidationData(). One-mode projections projectBoneGraph() projectMuscleGraph(), plus hyperedgeDegree(), vertexDegree(), degreeDistribution(). mskSimulate() sets spring-mass system (spring constant 1/(deg-1) per muscle); mskImpactScore() mskImpactScoreAll() perturb muscles via velocity-Verlet integration 4th spatial dimension quantify network-wide displacement. mskNullHypergraph() / mskNullEnsemble() generate degree-preserving randomized null models, mskImpactDeviation() scores muscle degree-matched null distribution. mskCommunityDetect() mskConsensusPartition() run Louvain community detection (pure-R fallback igraph absent), mskModularity(), mskZRand(), mskConsensusPartition() consensus repeated runs. Centrality distance metrics via mskNetworkMetrics(), mskBetweenness() (Brandes), mskCloseness(), mskShortestPaths(). mskRobustRegression() (weighted / MASS::rlm robust fitting), mskImpactRecoveryModel(), mskHomuncCorrelation() reproduce impact-vs-recovery community-vs-homunculus results, mskReproducePaper() runs full validation pipeline end end. Base-graphics visualization: plotMSKNetwork(), plotDegreeDistribution(), plotCommunityStructure(), plotImpactVsDegree(), plotImpactVsRecovery(), plotHomunculus().

title: PhysioMSKNet 0.1.0
text: EMG bridge: emgToMSKMapping() matches EMG channels muscles, emgStructuralCoherence(), emgCommunityCompare(), emgMSKEnrichment() compare functional coherence activation network structure (Mantel test Welch-coherence fallback). MoCap IMU bridges: mocapToMSKMapping() / imuToMSKMapping() resolve segment sensor names bones, mocapNetworkKinematics(), mocapImpactPrediction(), mocapCommunityDynamics(), imuNetworkKinematics(), imuImpactPrediction(), imuCommunityDynamics() propagate kinematic stress movement synchrony network. OpenSim bridge: opensimToMSKHypergraph() builds hypergraph directly .osim model (parsing PathPoint attachments), opensimNetworkAnalysis(), opensimCompareModels(), opensimForceToImpact() force-weighted impact analysis. Neuromechanics bridge: corticomuscular directional coupling (neuromechCorticomuscularCoupling(), neuromechDirectionalCoupling() via Granger causality / transfer entropy), electromechanical delay (neuromechElectromechanicalDelay()), joint-torque estimation moment arms (neuromechJointTorque()), NMF/PCA muscle-synergy decomposition (neuromechMuscleSynergy()), motor-drive topography, integrated vulnerability, neuromechSummary() orchestrator. Knowledge-graph bridge (via PhysioAnnotationHub): mskAnnotate(), mskEnrichKG() (hypergeometric enrichment), mskPathwayQuery(), mskCommunityProfile(), mskClinicalEvidence(), mskKGSummary().
